technology.summary:
Today's technology news includes a number of AI-related stories. Microsoft has debuted new AI-friendly hardware and Windows changes, while Nvidia is betting on physical AI to make safer robotaxis and humanoid robots. AI-native software startup Vesta has raised $30 million to bring AI agents to mortgage lenders, and Google has released a new AI app to compete with Granola.

In other news, China's Manus has raised over $500 million in its first funding round since splitting with Meta, and Uber and China's Pony.ai plan to launch robotaxis in London. India has rejected Elon Musk's claim of discrimination over the Starlink launch, and GTA VI leaks continue with a lengthy (and very nude) gameplay video.

citations.headline: Microsoft event debuts new AI-friendly hardware and Windows changes
Nvidia's big bet on physical AI aims for safer robotaxis, humanoid robots
Vesta raises $30M to bring swarms of agents to mortgage lenders
Google releases a new local-first Granola competitor
China’s Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
Uber and China’s Pony.ai plan to launch robotaxis in London
India rejects Elon Musk’s claim of discrimination over Starlink launch
GTA VI leaks continue with a lengthy (and very nude) gameplay video

finance.summary: Today's most important finance news includes a decline in Indian equity benchmarks due to profit booking and rising oil prices, with the Nifty 50 index closing down by 95.75 points. The Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India have joined forces to streamline regulatory procedures and facilitate foreign portfolio investors' entry into the market. A landmark Supreme Court ruling in India has exposed steep markups on cancer drugs in hospitals, causing a 5% drop in the BSE Hospitals Index. Southeast Asian debt is under pressure due to a resurgent El Niño pattern, rising US Treasury rates, and oil prices.

citations.headline: Stocks in news: Infosys, HDFC Bank, Jio Financial, IRFC, NCC and Blue Dart
Sebi, RBI join hands to make onboarding easier for FPIs
Hospital stocks slip after SC query on steep cancer drug markups
El Niño to Compound Drag on Southeast Asian Debt, Analysts Say

politics.summary: Today's most important politics news includes the Delhi High Court's dismissal of pleas for an SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence, and the Supreme Court's decision to list a plea to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar. Congress has claimed that tribal students headed for a protest in Mumbai were detained, and protesters are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Meanwhile, former US President Donald Trump has called the US electoral process 'corrupt', citing an Indian election that did not happen.

Supreme Court to list plea to allow peaceful protests  to Jantar Mantar

"No Instructions": Delhi Police On Cops Without Name Tags At Protest
